Must run entirely in air-gapped SCIF for classified workflows; unclassified ancillary services can use Dedicated. Priority: deterministic performance, verifiable artifact provenance, HSM-backed keying.
technical_requirements: Air-gapped deployment image (OCI or tarball) with signed manifests and checksums
Integration with on-prem Thales HSM via KMIP (no cloud KMS)
No outbound telemetry by default; optional signed metrics bundle transfer
Model pinning and offline rollout capabilities (no automatic downloads)
Support for quantized model variants to meet GPU memory constraints
poC_success_criteria: Isolated inference node responds to chat prompts inside SCIF with per-token latency <120ms for baseline model
Throughput >= 20 requests/sec at 512-token avg prompt within lab cluster
Complete artifact verification: SHA256 manifest, signing key check, and HSM unwrap verified
NO outbound network traffic during inference and telemetry only via manual signed bundle
